It names `library/constant_time_impl.h` for the primitives and `library/constant_time.c` for the out-of-line definitions of `mbedtls_ct_memcmp`, `mbedtls_ct_memcpy_if` and `mbedtls_ct_memcpy_offset`. It also refers to `constant_time_internal.h` for the C-fallback comment and the declarations, and to the `constant_time.h` doc for the `mbedtls_ct_memcmp()` note. It says "the three `constant_time*` files" hold about 100 of the uses.
